entities.summary: Marquette King Jr. is an American former professional football player who was a punter in the National Football League (NFL). He played college football for the Fort Valley State Wildcats and was signed by the Oakland Raiders of the National Football League (NFL) as an undrafted free agent in 2012. King led the NFL in punting yards in 2014.
